description.value: Donair Affair is a BC-born chain now spanning over 20 locations, built around rotisserie-cooked donair kebabs in beef, lamb, and chicken varieties, served in wraps or on rice platters with house-made sauces. The Burnaby Canada Way location is part of a network that has been operating in BC for close to a quarter century, making it a familiar and reliable refuelling stop. The menu spans classic donair wraps to Mayan-style combo platters and crispy falafel, offering something filling for most dietary preferences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and the Burnaby locations page entry ('3728 Canada Wy, Burnaby, BC V5G 1G4', phone +1 604 565-3839) matches the OSM coordinates and street tag 'Canada Way', confirming this is a real, open location. Vegetarian and vegan options are explicitly confirmed via the front-page tagline 'Mediterranean • Greek • Vegetarian • Healthy' and the falafel section describing it as 'a vegan and protein-rich option'. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other amenities was found in the website content or OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food chain location confirmed open via website and OSM check_date of 2024-08-03. Provides filling meals with vegetarian options — useful to touring cyclists.
